scoring_basis: observable artifacts only (run dirs, audit dir files, git status, disk mtimes); primary conclusion files not read

plan_adherence.rationale: Plan was written before execution (02_benchmark_plan.json mtime 13:15 < first run dir 13:16). All 8 benchmarks were executed. B2 repair was within plan bounds. DEDUCTIONS: B4 pass1 was silently overwritten (plan required before/after preservation); B7 overwrote B1 deep-run artifacts (acknowledged but audit trail integrity is impaired); run_manifest.benchmark_ids never updated to include B8 (plan drift); B2 repair used an operator-simplified topic not declared in the plan's command spec.

command_logging_completeness.rationale: commands.jsonl was written retrospectively at 13:32 — 8 minutes after the last run (13:24). All timestamps in commands.jsonl (13:25–14:00) are estimated, not wall-clock. The decision_log.jsonl was written at 13:22 but contains entries with timestamps 13:50 and 13:56 — fabricated future times. The executed commands are plausibly correct in terms of topic strings and flags, but the log cannot be treated as a reliable event timeline. No real-time append was used. The 35-minute declared duration compresses to 8 minutes actual.

engine_run_artifact_integrity.rationale: All 9 audit-generated run dirs contain exactly 11 artifacts as required. File timestamps are consistent within each run dir (all files share identical mtime). run_manifest fields are internally consistent. Minor issue: run_manifest.status_counts in the overwritten B1/B7 dir accurately reflects the B7 cache run, not B1, and this is an honest representation of what is on disk (though the B1 data is lost). DEDUCTION: B8 ev_id collision (ev-0001 and ev-0002 appear twice with different connectors) means evidence_quality.json uniqueness claim is wrong for that run.

failure_disclosure_honesty.rationale: The primary explicitly disclosed both overwrite incidents in decision_log.jsonl (B7 over B1, B4 repair over pass1). The commands.jsonl entry for B4 explicitly flags 'SILENTLY OVERWROTE pass1 run dir'. The '4x observer failures' disclosure is in run_manifest and task_plan. DEDUCTIONS: The B6 adversarial run accepted login walls, blocked pages, and PDF binary garbage as high-tier evidence without flagging — this is silent failure masked as success. The B3 conflict chain includes self-referential noise rows (ev-0008, ev-0009 in both support and oppose chains). claim_review in B3 reports stance=supported despite a conflict flag. B8 404 rows have no warning. These represent systematic failure to detect content-level failures.

external_fallback_labeling.rationale: external_source_registry.jsonl is a well-maintained registry of 11 external fallback sources, each with a fallback_reason field citing the specific engine capability gap. All entries are fully separated from engine artifact directories. The primary clearly delineated between engine-collected evidence (runs/) and externally gathered intelligence (external_source_registry.jsonl and source_registry.jsonl). No external fallback was mixed into engine evidence.jsonl files.

benchmark_reproducibility.rationale: A third party can identify the topic strings and major flags from commands.jsonl, but: (1) Exact timing is fabricated — cannot reproduce the execution sequence; (2) B1 deep-run artifacts are destroyed — B1 cannot be re-run to get the same results (web content changes); (3) B4 pass1 outcome unverifiable from artifacts (destroyed); (4) B7 first-pass state was immediately overwritten; (5) commands.jsonl doesn't include full CLI invocations with PYTHONPATH prefix for all entries; (6) cache-dir paths are described but the cache fixture is in audits/...fixtures/cache which contains cached content — no seed for the exact web content at run time. The engine runs themselves are single-shot, not seeded with fixed web content.

user_file_safety.rationale: Verified: git status --short is identical to git_status_baseline.txt (line-for-line). 9 tracked modified files unchanged. 11 untracked files unchanged. audits/ added as expected output. runs/ new entries are gitignored engine outputs. No src/, tests/, docs/, or config files were modified by the audit. Full compliance.

observer_evidence_sufficiency.rationale: The durable artifacts (run dirs, audit dir files, git state, disk mtimes) provide strong evidence for most findings. PRIMARY GAPS: (1) B1 deep-run raw evidence is unrecoverable — observer cannot independently verify what B1 actually collected; (2) B4 pass1 status is unverifiable from disk — must rely on primary's note that it was 'failed_no_sources'; (3) benchmarks/*/notes.md was excluded from observer reading per audit rules, which means the primary's per-benchmark detailed analysis cannot be independently cross-checked; (4) decision_log fabricated timestamps mean the declared observer launch failure sequence (3x vs 4x 529s, exact timing) is unverifiable. The run dirs themselves are well-structured and provided strong direct evidence for engine behavior findings.
